items.title: John Heard interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I guess I’m going to be working with Al Grey, Harry “Sweets” Edison, Junior Mance and a drummer, Bobby Dorn.

ctx.x: Where is it. It’s in LA, next week with The Elders. And I guess I’m going to be working with Al Grey, Harry “Sweets” Edison, Junior Mance and a drummer, Bobby Dorn. We’re going to be doing some things on the west coast.
All right. Junior Mance. ©Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
